governing_invariants: Implementation correctness does not imply authorization.
Approval does not imply execution permission.
Resolver RESOLVED does not imply Authority, Human Approval, Bind authorization, admissibility, or execution permission.
Uncertainty, contradiction, mutation, delay, or provenance loss may weaken a conclusion but must never strengthen it.
No activation-review artifact may self-authorize activation.
Activation evidence must be independently challengeable and auditable by a reviewer separate from the implementation author and activation requester.

activation_target_boundary.description: If later approved, activation may only make the existing separate_store_readonly_v1 resolver callable from one explicitly named evidence-only consumer. It does not authorize any effect-bearing path.
activation_target_boundary.note: The exact caller/consumer is intentionally not named yet; therefore activation is not currently justifiable.
